caption: The drawing features a symmetrical design centered on a large circular mandala at the bottom, composed of repeating geometric shapes in blue, red, and yellow with a radiating pattern. Above the mandala, there are two stylized yellow wings with red accents, one on each side of the center. Between and above the wings is a blue and yellow bow-shaped form with red dots and an outlined circle at the center. At the uppermost part of the composition is a yellow cross outlined in red with blue interior accents and radiating yellow lines behind it, resembling rays of light. The entire image has a textured, beige background with a darker gradient at the edges.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
